verdict.rationale: Warp documents a right-click 'Ask Warp AI' action that explains any error in command output, demystifies opaque error messages and identifies missing dependencies (warp-docs-9, warp-docs-29). Its agent also covers debugging and fixing errors and interpreting command results, with context attachable from output blocks (warp-docs-44, warp-docs-58). missing for 10: documentation of automatic or proactive fix suggestions when a command fails (the documented flow is manual right-click), concrete detail on how suggested fixes are presented and applied, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the error-explanation feature.
